display.title: T3: The Chemical Crystallizer
display.subtitle: 5x ore, the final stage
description: The §bChemical Crystallizer§r closes the §b5x ore§r chain - it crystallizes
the processed slurry back into clean material, completing Enrichment ->
Purification -> Injection -> Crystallizer for the full five-ingot yield.
Build a Chemical Crystallizer to complete this beat and finish the chain the
whole Engineering lane has climbed toward.
§7With all four machines you reach true 5x ore - the apex of T3 processing.
